snippet.title: Yume Nikki Fangame playthrough - Tsukodome ver. 0.0.3
snippet.description:
Content warning:
- Blood, gore, and violence
- Depiction of suicide
- Depiction of murder
- Depiction of self-harm
- Depiction of internal organs
- Body horror
- Bright lights
- Loud noises
- Jumpscares

Read more about this fangame: https://ynfg.yume.wiki/Tsukodome_(%E9%80%9A%E8%80%83%E6%AD%A2%E3%82%81)_
Download: https://bowlroll.net/file/317441

TIMESTAMPS:
Hikutsuki's part
0:00 Starting her part, Getting Glass Shard ITEM
3:09 Getting Angel and Japanese Bindweed EFFECTS
5:18 Getting Sign, Funeral Portrait, and Sailor Uniform EFFECTS, Exploring the School
9:55 Getting The Ruin of What One Was EFFECT
12:14 Getting Butterfly Knot EFFECT
13:23 Getting Tanuki EFFECT
16:34 Getting Braids, Side Ponytail, and Monochrome EFFECTS
19:20 Getting FC EFFECT
25:05 Getting Freezing EFFECT
28:44 Getting Amputation EFFECT
31:14 Getting Psyllium EFFECT
32:52 Spending money on a vending machine
33:54 Getting Unsuccessful EFFECT
34:58 Seeing ENDING 1
36:01 Dropping off all effects (must make sure to both get and drop off Unsuccessful or it won't count for Ending 2)
37:42 Seeing ENDING 2

Uwabami's part
38:50 Switching to Uwabami, Starting his part
40:24 Getting School Boy, Tailcoat, Garrote, and Molting EFFECTS
46:55 Getting warped back to Teleport Maze
47:38 Getting Owl EFFECT
49:00 Getting Deer EFFECT
50:03 Getting Convulsions EFFECT
